  • Method Details

    • feed

      public String feed(Actor farmer, Location farmerLocation)
      Applies the effect of feeding this Chicken: restores 3 HP (without exceeding its maximum HP) and drops one Egg on a tile adjacent to the Farmer, with a 50% chance of a second Egg being dropped as well.
      Parameters:
      farmer - the Actor doing the feeding
      farmerLocation - the Location of the Farmer
      Returns:
      a description of the outcome, to be displayed to the player
